**Key finding:** No public IT conference exists in Courchevel. The nearest is **Les Sommets** (formerly Les Sommets du Digital) in Méribel — same Les 3 Vallées ski valley, ski-lift accessible — running March 29–31, 2026 with AI/Microsoft/France Digitale speakers. Courchevel itself only offers private corporate seminar infrastructure (convention center, 360-seat auditorium; Hôtel Koh-I Nor up to 400 seats). The ski+startup conference concept exists at SKInnovation in Innsbruck but has no French Alps equivalent.
